dogecoin.text:
@cryptojack Meme coins like Dogecoin and Shiba Inu surged to a $90B market cap in 2021, yet most lack utility or tech backing—pure hype drives them. 
When 80% of their value can vanish in months, are they investments or just digital lottery tickets?

@CryptoNewsFlas3 Dogecoin to Hit $2, But at What Cost? Analysts are split, with some claiming DOGE could soar to $2 by 2030, while others warn of a crypto bubble ready to burst. Is this the future of money or a gamble with no safety net?
